annotations.title: Check for anti-dumping duty on Chinese goods

description: Check Chinese goods for trade defence duties. market defaults to uk: uses the live UK Trade Tariff, with no single rate because it depends on the exporter. market eu: searches the sourced EU snapshot by product keyword or CN code prefix and gives indicative ranges and EUR-Lex regulations. Always check TARIC before EU import; no match is not clearance.

commodity_code.description: UK: a 6 to 10 digit commodity code (required). EU: a CN code prefix; alternatively supply product.

locale.description: Language for names and links: en (default) or zh (Simplified Chinese).

product.description: EU only: product keyword in English or Chinese.

name: check_anti_dumping
title: Check for anti-dumping duty on Chinese goods
